text:
alina: Who's up for a PC LAN + BBQ next Saturday at the office rooftop? Thinking late afternoon into evening, bring your rig or a console, burgers on me. :meat_on_bone: :video_game:

marc: Ooh yes. Can bring my 144Hz monitor and a spare switch (8-port). What's the power situation up there?

tony: We should be careful about circuits. Last time the microwave tripped the floor breaker. @facilities any max amps / grill rules for rooftop?

facilities-bot: Reminder: rooftop events require a facilities request form 72h in advance. Power limit per event: 40A across two circuits. No open-flame grills without permit. Electric grills OK with prior approval. Form: https://office.example/rooftop-request

yara: I can bring an electric hibachi-style grill and a bunch of extension cords. Also can bring a Cat6 patch cable reel and a powered 16-port switch if needed.

alina: Perfect. Marc + Yara = extra networking. Tony, can you bring a few power strips and label them for circuit balancing?

tony: Yep, I have 4 heavy-duty 15A strips. I'll label them L1/L2 and try to spread rigs. Suggest we assign people to a circuit when they arrive.

marc: I'll bring my desktop (i7 / 4070), monitor, keyboard. Anyone need a spare GPU barrel or any peripherals?

yara: I have an extra Steam Deck dock and two ethernet dongles. Also happy to run DHCP on a small subnet so people can join without messing with office Wi-Fi. devops-bot, can we reserve 10.77.5.0/24 for the LAN?

devops-bot: Tentative yes. Please submit a temporary network request including MAC list and times. Approval required 24h before event. Portal: https://infra.example/network-requests

alina: Cool. Quick poll: react with :computer: if you're bringing a desktop, :joypad: for console/portable only, and :hamburger: if you want veg options.

marc: :computer: :hamburger:

ton y: :computer: (bringing power strips)

yara: :joypad: :hamburger:

alina: :computer: I'll smoke some portobello for vegetarians.

tony: Also FYI bring headphones or we'll get noise complaints. Headphone amp for comms? Can set up a Discord voice channel.

marc: Discord channel sounds good. I'll run a small Flatpak game server if network allows — maybe Factorio or Quake? low-latency party games too.

alina: Awesome. I'll submit rooftop + network forms today and ping facilities once approved. If anyone needs to borrow a monitor stand or hand truck for moving gear, shout here.

yara: I'll DM the list of items I'll bring and the patching plan. See you Saturday! :party_popper:
